_readme: Everything the economy does lives here. Edit and restart; no code changes needed. goods: base price + target stock (price rises when stock < target). buildings: what each building makes/buys/starts with ('buys': '*' means it takes any good). cities: where, which 9 buildings (3x3 blocks), palette, tone. merchants: the travelling traders. events: random happenings that move prices or supply. Prices: ask = base * scarcity * ask_margin, bid = base * scarcity * bid_margin; scarcity = ((target+1)/(stock+1))^elasticity clamped to [min,max], then multiplied by any active event for that good and city.

copperhead.name: Copperhead
copperhead.likes: iron, gems and being left alone

highmarket.name: Highmarket
highmarket.likes: a bargain, a rumour and a bit of everything

arrive: Fresh from %s! Mind the mud, it is mostly %s.
Straight from %s with a cart of %s and a bad knee.
%s was lovely. I brought %s. Everything else was moist.
leave: Off to %s. Wish me luck. And a dry cart.
Heading to %s. If I am not back, I am rich.

events.name: Harvest Fair
events.text: A fair is on in %s! Ale and bread are going like hot cakes.
events.npc: Everyone is drunk on the fair. Even the cat.

events.name: Wheat Blight
events.text: Blight in the fields near %s. Wheat is scarce and bread follows.
events.npc: The wheat went all grey. Like my uncle.

events.name: Great Fish Run
events.text: The fish are running at %s! Nets are bursting.
events.npc: So many fish. I have started naming them.

events.name: Tunnel Collapse
events.text: A tunnel collapsed near %s. Ore will be dear for a while.
events.npc: The mine fell in. Gave it a stern talking-to.

events.name: Far Caravan
events.text: A caravan from beyond the hills reached %s with spice and silk.
events.npc: Smells like cinnamon and bad decisions.

events.name: Road Raiders
events.text: Raiders (wolves, mostly) are prowling the roads near %s. Merchants are nervous.
events.npc: Wolves on the road! Wolves! Not the good kind.

glut: %s is cheap in %s because the shelves are full. %s
reasons.travel: A merchant named %s is hauling %s from %s to %s. That should even things out.
reasons.nothing: Prices are steady. Boring, but honest.

greet: Lovely day for a bit of trade!
Welcome to Sunny Town. We have bread and opinions.
Mind the pigeons. They are unionised.
cheery.scarce: Gosh, ran out of %s. Terribly sorry about that.
joke: I tried to sell a cloud once. Went for a song.
My bread is so good the ducks complain about the ones in the pond.
Why did the coin cross the road? To get to the other tide.
I am not saying the guard is lazy, but his shadow does his patrols.

greet: State your business or buy something.
Mind the dust. It is mostly ore. And regret.
gruff.glut: Drowning in %s. Take it, it's yours.
joke: Dug a hole to find happiness. Found a worse hole.
A gem is just a rock with ambition.
Miners do not get lost. We get 'rerouted'.
Last foreman fell down a shaft. Had a lovely echo.

greet: Ahoy! Mind the gulls, they steal sandwiches.
Welcome to Saltmere, where the fish are fresh and the stories are fresher.
Smells like fish? That is the money.
salty.scarce: The %s ran dry. Blame the tide.
salty.glut: More %s than a net can hold! Buy some, I beg you.
joke: I caught a fish so big it caught me back.
Why is the sea salty? It never learned to stop crying about the shore.
I named my boat 'Nauti Buoy'. The harbourmaster was not amused.
Fish are just wet birds, change my mind.

greet: A customer! Do come in, do come in.
Highmarket: if we do not have it, you did not need it.
Psst. Spice? Silk? A rumour? All on sale.
slick.scarce: %s is rare, which makes it a bargain at any price.
slick.glut: %s? Practically free. I am practically weeping.
joke: A bargain is just a loss with good PR.
I once sold a map to a man who was standing on the thing it showed.
Everything has a price. Mine is just fashionably high.
Sold a haunted bucket yesterday. It came back. Sold it again.

npc_jokes: I would tell you a joke about paper, but it is tearable.
Cardboard is the best material. You can always box your feelings.
My boss said I should think outside the box. I am a cutout. That is all I can do.
I get flat jokes. They have no depth.
Do not lean on me. I fold under pressure.
I tried to pay with a coin. Got a receipt written on a coin.
The guard says the wolves are 'basically puppies'. He has no left arm.
I asked the baker for a loaf. He said 'dough not'. I do not get it either.
Slimes are very supportive. They always stick by you.
I stood up straight today. Nobody noticed. I am very thin.
